# Application Responses and Transport Boundaries

Network Systems, Unit 11: Common Application Protocols.

A protocol specifies how peers interpret messages. A port identifies one part
of a transport endpoint; its number alone does not prove which application
answered. An observed TCP connection, HTTP response, trusted TLS identity and
successful application operation answer different questions. This lab supplies
one real HTTP service to make those distinctions inspectable.

Use Python 3.10 or newer, curl and ss in an external Linux terminal under an
ordinary account. No root account is needed. The program binds only 127.0.0.1
on a newly allocated port. It does not query a public host or change interfaces,
routes, firewall rules, resolver files, credentials or existing services. Keep
main.py, application_lab.py, network-notes.md and application-cases.md together.
The root README.md is this complete guide; the role README.md identifies the
selected role. Run from starter/ for an attempt or solution/ for a separate
reference. Both roles collect the same real observations. Python programming is
optional; only analyze(evidence) is incomplete in the starter.

An HTTP request combines a method, target, version and fields. The service replies
with a status, fields and, when appropriate, content. Read actual bytes before
interpreting them. Content-Type describes the representation; Content-Length
counts octets. A HEAD reply has metadata without transferred representation
content. The record includes base64 for exact binary bytes, because decoding
arbitrary content as text can destroy evidence. The laboratory deliberately
closes each connection, allowing its raw client to retain bytes through EOF.
It is a small HTTP/1.1 experiment, not a general HTTP parser or production server.

The report keeps the issuing namespace, ordinary UID, owned child PID, loopback
address and allocated port. Match the ss listener row to that PID and compare
the unique response token with the worker's request log. Client local/peer
addresses and server local/peer addresses should agree in opposite directions.
The two curl requests corroborate the raw client using another implementation.
A separate socket holds a different loopback port without listening while curl
attempts a connection. Its refusal supplies a controlled comparison without a
successful HTTP response. A general timeout or refusal elsewhere would need
additional authorized evidence before assigning a cause.

## Required protocol observations

Run `python3 main.py` and retain its JSON as a new observation record. Predict the
five method/path outcomes first: GET /state, HEAD /state, GET /missing, POST /state
and GET /unavailable. The first reply transfers a JSON representation containing
the run's token, message and server identity. Compare its byte count with the
advertised length. The HEAD reply describes that representation while the raw
connection transfers no content. An empty HEAD body is expected behavior.

The missing resource produces HTTP 404. The unsupported method produces HTTP
405 with Allow naming GET and HEAD. The planned local unavailability produces
HTTP 503 with a Retry-After value. These are actual application messages from
the owned service. They establish that an HTTP exchange occurred, even when
the requested operation did not succeed. The held-port curl refusal has no
HTTP status line; keep that transport observation in a different table column.

Repeat with `python3 main.py --changed --message "Second observation"`.
Predict which facts should change: the message and suggested retry delay do;
the per-run token and allocated endpoint may also change. The distinction
between HEAD content and GET content, the missing path and allowed methods
remain. Compare independent runs using their own identities, not one remembered
port. A 503 Retry-After suggestion does not show that the service later recovered.
The script does not wait and automatically retry that unavailable route.

## Connect this evidence to other application protocols

DNS can provide an address answer, a negative name answer or a protocol-level
error. A successful DNS answer still does not demonstrate this HTTP service.
Use the earlier name-resolution exercise for actual DNS/NSS observations.
HTTPS adds TLS: a certificate trust or name failure may prevent HTTP from being
reached. SSH involves server host identity and account authentication; a
successful TCP connection alone establishes neither. Read the three explicitly
constructed cases in application-cases.md and name the earliest unsupported
boundary. They are reasoning exercises, not packets captured by this program.

## Deliverable and review

Complete network-notes.md with predictions, the two actual runs, response bytes,
transport comparison, issuing host/namespace, method, target, token, endpoint,
owner, observed status and cleanup. Preserve unexpected results with their raw
errors and identify the next authorized observation that would distinguish two
plausible explanations. Finish with the supplied-case comparisons and one
limit on each conclusion. Verify serverReaped and the PID's absence from the
final listener query. For paced review, pause after the prediction, each
request/response pair, the refusal comparison and the closing diagnosis.

Optional Python practice: implement analyze(evidence) to summarize the five
observed statuses, actual HEAD byte count, allowed methods and whether the
refusal produced an HTTP response. Work from the collected records. Keep the
reference separate and compare only after completing an attempt.

## Protocol reference

For HTTP terminology and the method/status rules, consult
[RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html),
especially sections 8.6, 9.3.2, 13.1.2, 15.4.5, 15.4.8, 15.5.6 and 15.6.4.
The observations and service behavior described above are specific to this lab.

import argparse
import json

import sys

import application_lab


def analyze(evidence):
    """Optional Python practice; the actual observations work without this summary."""

def interrupted(signum, _frame):
    raise SystemExit(128 + signum)


def main():
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupted)
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--message", default="Owned application observation")
    parser.add_argument("--changed", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--hold-ms", type=int, default=0)

"""Observe bounded HTTP exchanges with an owned ordinary-user loopback service."""
import base64
import contextlib
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import select
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from pathlib import Path


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def encoded(raw):
    return base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")


def command(argv, evidence):
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                             start_new_session=True)
    cleanup = "exited and reaped"
    try:
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=4)
    except BaseException:
        cleanup = "owned process group stopped and reaped"
        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.communicate(timeout=2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            child.communicate(timeout=2)
        raise
    finally:
        evidence["commands"].append({
            "parentTask": "application-protocol-observation", "parentPid": os.getpid(),
            "cwd": os.getcwd(), "command": argv, "pid": child.pid,
            "startTime": started, "endTime": now(), "exitCode": child.returncode,
            "timeoutSeconds": 4, "childProcessGroupCleanup": cleanup,
        })
    record = evidence["commands"][-1]
    record.update(stdout=out.decode("utf-8"), stderr=err.decode("utf-8"))
    return record


def serve(token, message, retry):
    requests = []

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        server_version = "OwnedApplicationLab/1"
        sys_version = ""

        def log_message(self, _format, *_args):
            pass

        def do_GET(self):
            self.respond()

        def do_HEAD(self):
            self.respond()

        def do_POST(self):
            self.respond()

        def respond(self):
            data = {"token": token, "message": message, "pid": os.getpid(),
                    "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
                    "port": self.server.server_port}
            representation = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True).encode() + b"\n"
            etag = '"' + hashlib.sha256(representation).hexdigest() + '"'
            status = 200
            fields = {"Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"}
            body = representation
            if self.command == "POST":
                status, fields["Allow"] = 405, "GET, HEAD"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "method not allowed"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/state":
                fields["ETag"] = etag
                fields["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
                if self.headers.get("If-None-Match") == etag:
                    status, body = 304, b""
            elif self.path == "/redirect":
                status, fields["Location"] = 307, "/state"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "next": "/state"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/unavailable":
                status, fields["Retry-After"] = 503, str(retry)
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "planned local unavailability"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/binary":
                fields["Content-Type"], body = "application/octet-stream", b"\x00\x01\xff\xfe"
            else:
                status = 404
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "resource not found"}).encode() + b"\n"
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Connection", "close")
            self.send_header("X-Lab-Token", token)
            for key, value in fields.items():
                self.send_header(key, value)
            # A 304 has no content. Omit Content-Length rather than advertising
            # a length that differs from the selected 200 representation.
            if status != 304:
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            actual_body = b"" if self.command == "HEAD" else body
            self.wfile.write(actual_body)
            self.wfile.flush()
            requests.append({
                "at": now(), "method": self.command, "path": self.path,
                "requestLine": self.raw_requestline.decode("ascii"),
                "requestHeaders": dict(self.headers), "status": status,
                "bodyBase64": encoded(actual_body), "etag": fields.get("ETag"),
                "local": list(self.connection.getsockname()),
                "peer": list(self.connection.getpeername()),
            })

    def stop(_signum, _frame):
        raise KeyboardInterrupt

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, stop)
    signal.alarm(45)
    server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
    server.timeout = 2
    ready = {"pid": os.getpid(), "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
             "port": server.server_port, "token": token}
    print(json.dumps({"ready": ready}), flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.05)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        print(json.dumps({"worker": ready, "requests": requests}), flush=True)
    return 0


def read_ready(child):
    readable, _, _ = select.select([child.stdout], [], [], 3)
    if not readable:
        raise TimeoutError("owned HTTP service did not announce readiness")
    raw = child.stdout.readline()
    if not raw or len(raw) > 2048:
        raise ValueError("invalid HTTP service readiness")
    return raw.decode("ascii"), json.loads(raw)["ready"]


def exchange(port, method, path, extra=None, host=None):
    host = host or "127.0.0.1:" + str(port)
    fields = {"Host": host, "Connection": "close", **(extra or {})}
    if method == "POST":
        fields["Content-Length"] = "0"
    request = (method + " " + path + " HTTP/1.1\r\n" +
               "".join(key + ": " + value + "\r\n" for key, value in fields.items()) +
               "\r\n").encode("ascii")
    started = now()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
    chunks, size = [], 0
    with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=2) as client:
        local, peer = list(client.getsockname()), list(client.getpeername())
        client.sendall(request)
        while True:
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                raise TimeoutError("HTTP response exceeded its overall deadline")
            client.settimeout(min(2, remaining))
            chunk = client.recv(4096)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
            if size > 65536:
                raise ValueError("HTTP response exceeded its size boundary")
    raw = b"".join(chunks)
    header, body = raw.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)
    lines = header.decode("ascii").split("\r\n")
    version, status, reason = lines[0].split(" ", 2)
    headers = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        key, value = line.split(":", 1)
        key = key.lower()
        if key in headers:
            raise ValueError("unexpected repeated response header")
        headers[key] = value.strip()
    return {"method": method, "path": path, "requestHeaders": fields,
            "requestBase64": encoded(request), "responseBase64": encoded(raw),
            "version": version, "status": int(status), "reason": reason,
            "headers": headers, "bodyBase64": encoded(body),
            "local": local, "peer": peer, "startTime": started, "endTime": now(),
            "readToEOF": True, "deadlineSeconds": 3, "responseLimitBytes": 65536}


def observe(kind, message, changed, hold_ms, evidence):
    if sys.platform != "linux" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise ValueError("use an ordinary account in an external Linux terminal")
    if kind not in ("core", "transfer", "extension"):
        raise ValueError("unknown application-protocol task")
    if not message or len(message.encode()) > 160 or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in message):
        raise ValueError("message must contain 1 to 160 printable UTF-8 bytes")
    if not 0 <= hold_ms <= 2000:
        raise ValueError("hold milliseconds must be between 0 and 2000")
    curl, ss = shutil.which("curl"), shutil.which("ss")
    if not curl or not ss:
        raise ValueError("curl and ss are required")
    retry = 2 if changed else 1
    evidence.update(kind=kind, environment={"platform": sys.platform, "uid": os.geteuid(),
                    "parentPid": os.getpid(), "networkNamespace": os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")},
                    message=message, changed=changed, retrySeconds=retry,
                    commands=[], exchanges=[], configuredSystemState=False,
                    dnsMeasured=False, tlsMeasured=False, sshMeasured=False,
                    suppliedCasesAreConstructed=True, learnerWorksheetCompletionInferred=False)
    token = uuid.uuid4().hex
    argv = [sys.executable, "-u", str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--serve", token, message, str(retry)]
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    proc = {"parentTask": "application-protocol-observation", "parentPid": os.getpid(),
            "cwd": os.getcwd(), "command": argv, "pid": child.pid, "startTime": started,
            "timeoutSeconds": 45, "readinessDeadlineSeconds": 3,
            "stopDeadlineSeconds": 3, "childProcessGroupCleanup": "pending"}
    evidence["serverProcess"] = proc
    control = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    port = None
    try:
        control.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        evidence["refusalControl"] = {"address": "127.0.0.1", "port": control.getsockname()[1],
                                      "heldWithoutListen": True}
        raw, ready = read_ready(child)
        evidence.update(readyLine=raw, ready=ready)
        if ready["pid"] != child.pid or ready["uid"] != os.geteuid() or ready["token"] != token:
            raise ValueError("service identity mismatch")
        port = ready["port"]
        evidence["workerProcUidFields"] = next(line.split()[1:] for line in
            Path("/proc/" + str(child.pid) + "/status").read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("Uid:"))
        evidence["listenersDuring"] = command([ss, "-H", "-ltnp", "sport = :" + str(port)], evidence)["stdout"]
        time.sleep(hold_ms / 1000)
        plans = {
            "core": [("GET", "/state"), ("HEAD", "/state"), ("GET", "/missing"),
                     ("POST", "/state"), ("GET", "/unavailable")],
            "transfer": [("GET", "/state"), ("GET", "/state"), ("GET", "/state"),
                         ("HEAD", "/state"), ("GET", "/redirect"), ("GET", "/state")],
            "extension": [("GET", "/unavailable"), ("GET", "/missing"),
                          ("POST", "/state"), ("GET", "/binary"), ("GET", "/state")],
        }
        for i, (method, path) in enumerate(plans[kind]):
            extra = None
            if kind == "transfer" and i in (1, 2):
                extra = {"If-None-Match": evidence["exchanges"][0]["headers"]["etag"] if i == 1 else '"stale-version"'}
            host = "representation.invalid" if kind == "extension" and i == 4 else None
            evidence["exchanges"].append(exchange(port, method, path, extra, host))
        common = [curl, "--noproxy", "*", "--http1.1", "--silent", "--show-error",
                  "--include", "--connect-timeout", "1", "--max-time", "2"]
        evidence["curlGet"] = command([*common, "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["curlHead"] = command([*common, "--head", "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["curlRefusal"] = command([*common, "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(control.getsockname()[1]) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["refusalControl"]["heldDuringProbe"] = True
    finally:
        control.close()
        if child.poll() is None:
            with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        cleanup = "owned service stopped and reaped"
        try:
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=2)
            cleanup = "owned service killed after deadline and reaped"
        proc.update(endTime=now(), exitCode=child.returncode, childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup,
                    stdout=out.decode("ascii"), stderr=err.decode("utf-8"))
        evidence["serverReaped"] = child.poll() is not None
        for line in out.splitlines():
            message_record = json.loads(line)
            if "ready" in message_record and "ready" not in evidence:
                evidence.update(readyLine=line.decode("ascii") + "\n", ready=message_record["ready"])
                port = evidence["ready"]["port"]
            if "worker" in message_record:
                evidence["workerResult"] = message_record
        if port is not None:
            evidence["listenersAfter"] = command([ss, "-H", "-ltnp", "sport = :" + str(port)], evidence)["stdout"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 5 or sys.argv[1] != "--serve" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise SystemExit(2)
    raise SystemExit(serve(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4])))

# Constructed application-protocol cases

These fictional records are supplied for reasoning. They were not generated by
the loopback program and do not describe an external site.

## A: a negative DNS answer and a transport failure

An explicit DNS query to an authorized local resolver for missing.example.invalid
returns NXDOMAIN. Another query to a different selected resolver receives no
reply before its deadline. Neither record includes an application connection.
Identify which result is a DNS message and which has no received DNS response.
State what additional authorized observation is needed before blaming an HTTP
listener. Reuse the earlier DNS/NSS lab's distinction between explicit DNS and
system name-service lookup; do not treat this fictional table as a new lookup.

## B: TLS identity and an HTTP decision

One HTTPS client reports an untrusted certificate issuer before receiving any
HTTP status. A second, separately scoped test establishes a trusted TLS identity
for its intended host and receives HTTP 401. Explain why the two records do not
locate the same boundary. A 401 alone does not prove application account access.
Do not disable certificate checks as a substitute for identifying the intended
peer, applicable trust configuration and authorized authentication method.

## C: SSH server identity and account authentication

A client connects but reports a changed server host key. A separate connection
whose expected host key is independently verified reaches an account prompt and
ends with public-key authentication denied. Separate transport, host identity
and account authorization. Identify the trusted evidence needed before changing
a remembered host key. Neither record establishes a successful remote command.

For each case, preserve the stated issuing context, earliest unsupported
boundary, two possible explanations when appropriate, next authorized check and
what that check would fail to prove. No remediation is performed by this file.

            elif self.path == "/redirect":
                status, fields["Location"] = 307, "/state"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "next": "/state"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/unavailable":
                status, fields["Retry-After"] = 503, str(retry)
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "planned local unavailability"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/binary":
                fields["Content-Type"], body = "application/octet-stream", b"\x00\x01\xff\xfe"
            else:
                status = 404
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "resource not found"}).encode() + b"\n"
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Connection", "close")
            self.send_header("X-Lab-Token", token)
            for key, value in fields.items():
                self.send_header(key, value)
            # A 304 has no content. Omit Content-Length rather than advertising
            # a length that differs from the selected 200 representation.
            if status != 304:
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            actual_body = b"" if self.command == "HEAD" else body
            self.wfile.write(actual_body)
            self.wfile.flush()
            requests.append({
                "at": now(), "method": self.command, "path": self.path,
                "requestLine": self.raw_requestline.decode("ascii"),
                "requestHeaders": dict(self.headers), "status": status,
                "bodyBase64": encoded(actual_body), "etag": fields.get("ETag"),
                "local": list(self.connection.getsockname()),
                "peer": list(self.connection.getpeername()),
            })

    def stop(_signum, _frame):
        raise KeyboardInterrupt

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, stop)
    signal.alarm(45)
    server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
    server.timeout = 2
    ready = {"pid": os.getpid(), "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
             "port": server.server_port, "token": token}
    print(json.dumps({"ready": ready}), flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.05)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        print(json.dumps({"worker": ready, "requests": requests}), flush=True)
    return 0


def read_ready(child):
    readable, _, _ = select.select([child.stdout], [], [], 3)
    if not readable:
        raise TimeoutError("owned HTTP service did not announce readiness")
    raw = child.stdout.readline()
    if not raw or len(raw) > 2048:
        raise ValueError("invalid HTTP service readiness")
    return raw.decode("ascii"), json.loads(raw)["ready"]


def exchange(port, method, path, extra=None, host=None):
    host = host or "127.0.0.1:" + str(port)
    fields = {"Host": host, "Connection": "close", **(extra or {})}
    if method == "POST":
        fields["Content-Length"] = "0"
    request = (method + " " + path + " HTTP/1.1\r\n" +
               "".join(key + ": " + value + "\r\n" for key, value in fields.items()) +
               "\r\n").encode("ascii")
    started = now()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
    chunks, size = [], 0
    with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=2) as client:
        local, peer = list(client.getsockname()), list(client.getpeername())
        client.sendall(request)
        while True:
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                raise TimeoutError("HTTP response exceeded its overall deadline")
            client.settimeout(min(2, remaining))
            chunk = client.recv(4096)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
            if size > 65536:
                raise ValueError("HTTP response exceeded its size boundary")
    raw = b"".join(chunks)
    header, body = raw.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)
    lines = header.decode("ascii").split("\r\n")
    version, status, reason = lines[0].split(" ", 2)
    headers = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        key, value = line.split(":", 1)
        key = key.lower()
        if key in headers:
            raise ValueError("unexpected repeated response header")
        headers[key] = value.strip()
    return {"method": method, "path": path, "requestHeaders": fields,
            "requestBase64": encoded(request), "responseBase64": encoded(raw),
            "version": version, "status": int(status), "reason": reason,
            "headers": headers, "bodyBase64": encoded(body),
            "local": local, "peer": peer, "startTime": started, "endTime": now(),
            "readToEOF": True, "deadlineSeconds": 3, "responseLimitBytes": 65536}


def observe(kind, message, changed, hold_ms, evidence):
    if sys.platform != "linux" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise ValueError("use an ordinary account in an external Linux terminal")
    if kind not in ("core", "transfer", "extension"):
        raise ValueError("unknown application-protocol task")
    if not message or len(message.encode()) > 160 or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in message):
        raise ValueError("message must contain 1 to 160 printable UTF-8 bytes")
    if not 0 <= hold_ms <= 2000:
        raise ValueError("hold milliseconds must be between 0 and 2000")
    curl, ss = shutil.which("curl"), shutil.which("ss")
    if not curl or not ss:
        raise ValueError("curl and ss are required")
    retry = 2 if changed else 1
    evidence.update(kind=kind, environment={"platform": sys.platform, "uid": os.geteuid(),
                    "parentPid": os.getpid(), "networkNamespace": os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")},
                    message=message, changed=changed, retrySeconds=retry,
                    commands=[], exchanges=[], configuredSystemState=False,
                    dnsMeasured=False, tlsMeasured=False, sshMeasured=False,
                    suppliedCasesAreConstructed=True, learnerWorksheetCompletionInferred=False)
    token = uuid.uuid4().hex
    argv = [sys.executable, "-u", str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--serve", token, message, str(retry)]
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    proc = {"parentTask": "application-protocol-observation", "parentPid": os.getpid(),
            "cwd": os.getcwd(), "command": argv, "pid": child.pid, "startTime": started,
            "timeoutSeconds": 45, "readinessDeadlineSeconds": 3,
            "stopDeadlineSeconds": 3, "childProcessGroupCleanup": "pending"}
    evidence["serverProcess"] = proc
    control = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    port = None
    try:
        control.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        evidence["refusalControl"] = {"address": "127.0.0.1", "port": control.getsockname()[1],
                                      "heldWithoutListen": True}
        raw, ready = read_ready(child)
        evidence.update(readyLine=raw, ready=ready)
        if ready["pid"] != child.pid or ready["uid"] != os.geteuid() or ready["token"] != token:
            raise ValueError("service identity mismatch")
        port = ready["port"]
        evidence["workerProcUidFields"] = next(line.split()[1:] for line in
            Path("/proc/" + str(child.pid) + "/status").read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("Uid:"))
        evidence["listenersDuring"] = command([ss, "-H", "-ltnp", "sport = :" + str(port)], evidence)["stdout"]
        time.sleep(hold_ms / 1000)
        plans = {
            "core": [("GET", "/state"), ("HEAD", "/state"), ("GET", "/missing"),
                     ("POST", "/state"), ("GET", "/unavailable")],
            "transfer": [("GET", "/state"), ("GET", "/state"), ("GET", "/state"),
                         ("HEAD", "/state"), ("GET", "/redirect"), ("GET", "/state")],
            "extension": [("GET", "/unavailable"), ("GET", "/missing"),
                          ("POST", "/state"), ("GET", "/binary"), ("GET", "/state")],
        }
        for i, (method, path) in enumerate(plans[kind]):
            extra = None
            if kind == "transfer" and i in (1, 2):
                extra = {"If-None-Match": evidence["exchanges"][0]["headers"]["etag"] if i == 1 else '"stale-version"'}
            host = "representation.invalid" if kind == "extension" and i == 4 else None
            evidence["exchanges"].append(exchange(port, method, path, extra, host))
        common = [curl, "--noproxy", "*", "--http1.1", "--silent", "--show-error",
                  "--include", "--connect-timeout", "1", "--max-time", "2"]
        evidence["curlGet"] = command([*common, "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["curlHead"] = command([*common, "--head", "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["curlRefusal"] = command([*common, "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(control.getsockname()[1]) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["refusalControl"]["heldDuringProbe"] = True
    finally:
        control.close()
        if child.poll() is None:
            with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        cleanup = "owned service stopped and reaped"
        try:
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=2)
            cleanup = "owned service killed after deadline and reaped"
        proc.update(endTime=now(), exitCode=child.returncode, childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup,
                    stdout=out.decode("ascii"), stderr=err.decode("utf-8"))
        evidence["serverReaped"] = child.poll() is not None
        for line in out.splitlines():
            message_record = json.loads(line)
            if "ready" in message_record and "ready" not in evidence:
                evidence.update(readyLine=line.decode("ascii") + "\n", ready=message_record["ready"])
                port = evidence["ready"]["port"]
            if "worker" in message_record:
                evidence["workerResult"] = message_record
        if port is not None:
            evidence["listenersAfter"] = command([ss, "-H", "-ltnp", "sport = :" + str(port)], evidence)["stdout"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 5 or sys.argv[1] != "--serve" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise SystemExit(2)
    raise SystemExit(serve(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4])))

# Conditional Requests and Explicit Redirects

Network Systems, Unit 11: Common Application Protocols.

A protocol specifies how peers interpret messages. A port identifies one part
of a transport endpoint; its number alone does not prove which application
answered. An observed TCP connection, HTTP response, trusted TLS identity and
successful application operation answer different questions. This lab supplies
one real HTTP service to make those distinctions inspectable.

Use Python 3.10 or newer, curl and ss in an external Linux terminal under an
ordinary account. No root account is needed. The program binds only 127.0.0.1
on a newly allocated port. It does not query a public host or change interfaces,
routes, firewall rules, resolver files, credentials or existing services. Keep
main.py, application_lab.py, network-notes.md and application-cases.md together.
The root README.md is this complete guide; the role README.md identifies the
selected role. Run from starter/ for an attempt or solution/ for a separate
reference. Both roles collect the same real observations. Python programming is
optional; only analyze(evidence) is incomplete in the starter.

An HTTP request combines a method, target, version and fields. The service replies
with a status, fields and, when appropriate, content. Read actual bytes before
interpreting them. Content-Type describes the representation; Content-Length
counts octets. A HEAD reply has metadata without transferred representation
content. The record includes base64 for exact binary bytes, because decoding
arbitrary content as text can destroy evidence. The laboratory deliberately
closes each connection, allowing its raw client to retain bytes through EOF.
It is a small HTTP/1.1 experiment, not a general HTTP parser or production server.

The report keeps the issuing namespace, ordinary UID, owned child PID, loopback
address and allocated port. Match the ss listener row to that PID and compare
the unique response token with the worker's request log. Client local/peer
addresses and server local/peer addresses should agree in opposite directions.
The two curl requests corroborate the raw client using another implementation.
A separate socket holds a different loopback port without listening while curl
attempts a connection. Its refusal supplies a controlled comparison without a
successful HTTP response. A general timeout or refusal elsewhere would need
additional authorized evidence before assigning a cause.

## Optional transfer: validators and an explicit second request

This task extends the core protocol comparison by changing request conditions.
Run `python3 main.py`. Predict all six request outcomes before opening the
result. The initial GET /state returns a representation and an ETag validator.
The next request sends that exact validator in If-None-Match. This service
returns HTTP 304 without representation content. Keep the earlier bytes beside
the validating result: an empty 304 is not an empty replacement representation.
The helper records exchanges; it does not install a browser cache or persist a
cache entry. The retention table in the notebook is the explicit reasoning work.

A third GET sends a different, stale validator. Compare the returned status,
ETag and bytes with the initial representation. Explain why that condition did
not justify reusing an unvalidated local copy. The HEAD request then compares
metadata and transferred content independently of the conditional request.
Do not infer that a HEAD response has transferred the representation merely
because its Content-Length describes a positive number of octets.

The fifth exchange requests /redirect and receives HTTP 307 plus a relative
Location. The helper deliberately does not automatically follow that response.
Its sixth request explicitly addresses /state with GET, so both the redirect
and the destination result remain visible. Retain the method and target of
each exchange. This run demonstrates GET and a separately issued GET; it does
not test every redirect method rule, browser history or a cross-origin policy.

Repeat `python3 main.py --changed --message "Transfer observation"` as a fresh
run. The service is recreated, and its representation, validator and response
token belong to that new run. Explain why an ETag from the old run is not a
universal resource identity. The stale-validator request already gives a real
changed-condition comparison within each run. No proxy or shared cache is
started, and no cache lifetime or freshness clock is measured here.

## Evidence and a bounded interpretation

Fill network-notes.md with a six-row exchange table. Add the retained initial
body's SHA-256, the actual 304 byte count, the validator sent on each request,
the stale result, the redirect target and the explicitly requested destination.
Keep actual timing as observation timestamps, not a claim of benchmark speed.
Match every response to the current token and owned listener. The corroborating
curl requests and held-port refusal remain transport/application controls.
Check the final owned PID cleanup before ending the run.

Read the supplied DNS, TLS and SSH cases separately. Identify which extra
evidence each would need before a conditional HTTP request could even be made.
Their fictional observations are not part of the local request log. Distinguish
a negative DNS answer from a DNS transport failure, a TLS identity error from
an HTTP status, and SSH account authentication from host-key trust.

For independent work, write predictions before reading each response and
explain a result that would falsify the proposed reuse decision. For a paced
walkthrough, compare one conditional request at a time, then the two explicit
redirect exchanges. The task is complete when the retained representation,
conditions and observed outcomes support the explanation, including its limits.

Optional Python practice: implement analyze(evidence) to report the validator,
conditional status and transferred byte count, retained-body digest, stale
status, redirect status and Location, and equality of the final/initial body.
The separate reference implements this summary; networking interpretation and
the notebook remain the task even when no Python is written.

## Protocol reference

For HTTP terminology and the method/status rules, consult
[RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html),
especially sections 8.6, 9.3.2, 13.1.2, 15.4.5, 15.4.8, 15.5.6 and 15.6.4.
The observations and service behavior described above are specific to this lab.

"""Observe bounded HTTP exchanges with an owned ordinary-user loopback service."""
import base64
import contextlib
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import select
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from pathlib import Path


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def encoded(raw):
    return base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")


def command(argv, evidence):
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                             start_new_session=True)
    cleanup = "exited and reaped"
    try:
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=4)
    except BaseException:
        cleanup = "owned process group stopped and reaped"
        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.communicate(timeout=2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            child.communicate(timeout=2)
        raise
    finally:
        evidence["commands"].append({
            "parentTask": "application-protocol-observation", "parentPid": os.getpid(),
            "cwd": os.getcwd(), "command": argv, "pid": child.pid,
            "startTime": started, "endTime": now(), "exitCode": child.returncode,
            "timeoutSeconds": 4, "childProcessGroupCleanup": cleanup,
        })
    record = evidence["commands"][-1]
    record.update(stdout=out.decode("utf-8"), stderr=err.decode("utf-8"))
    return record


def serve(token, message, retry):
    requests = []

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        server_version = "OwnedApplicationLab/1"
        sys_version = ""

        def log_message(self, _format, *_args):
            pass

        def do_GET(self):
            self.respond()

        def do_HEAD(self):
            self.respond()

        def do_POST(self):
            self.respond()

        def respond(self):
            data = {"token": token, "message": message, "pid": os.getpid(),
                    "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
                    "port": self.server.server_port}
            representation = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True).encode() + b"\n"
            etag = '"' + hashlib.sha256(representation).hexdigest() + '"'
            status = 200
            fields = {"Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"}
            body = representation
            if self.command == "POST":
                status, fields["Allow"] = 405, "GET, HEAD"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "method not allowed"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/state":
                fields["ETag"] = etag
                fields["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
                if self.headers.get("If-None-Match") == etag:
                    status, body = 304, b""
            elif self.path == "/redirect":
                status, fields["Location"] = 307, "/state"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "next": "/state"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/unavailable":
                status, fields["Retry-After"] = 503, str(retry)
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "planned local unavailability"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/binary":
                fields["Content-Type"], body = "application/octet-stream", b"\x00\x01\xff\xfe"
            else:
                status = 404
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "resource not found"}).encode() + b"\n"
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Connection", "close")
            self.send_header("X-Lab-Token", token)
            for key, value in fields.items():
                self.send_header(key, value)
            # A 304 has no content. Omit Content-Length rather than advertising
            # a length that differs from the selected 200 representation.
            if status != 304:
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            actual_body = b"" if self.command == "HEAD" else body
            self.wfile.write(actual_body)
            self.wfile.flush()
            requests.append({
                "at": now(), "method": self.command, "path": self.path,
                "requestLine": self.raw_requestline.decode("ascii"),
                "requestHeaders": dict(self.headers), "status": status,
                "bodyBase64": encoded(actual_body), "etag": fields.get("ETag"),
                "local": list(self.connection.getsockname()),
                "peer": list(self.connection.getpeername()),
            })

    def stop(_signum, _frame):
        raise KeyboardInterrupt

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, stop)
    signal.alarm(45)
    server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
    server.timeout = 2
    ready = {"pid": os.getpid(), "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
             "port": server.server_port, "token": token}
    print(json.dumps({"ready": ready}), flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.05)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        print(json.dumps({"worker": ready, "requests": requests}), flush=True)
    return 0


def read_ready(child):
    readable, _, _ = select.select([child.stdout], [], [], 3)
    if not readable:
        raise TimeoutError("owned HTTP service did not announce readiness")
    raw = child.stdout.readline()
    if not raw or len(raw) > 2048:
        raise ValueError("invalid HTTP service readiness")
    return raw.decode("ascii"), json.loads(raw)["ready"]


def exchange(port, method, path, extra=None, host=None):
    host = host or "127.0.0.1:" + str(port)
    fields = {"Host": host, "Connection": "close", **(extra or {})}
    if method == "POST":
        fields["Content-Length"] = "0"
    request = (method + " " + path + " HTTP/1.1\r\n" +
               "".join(key + ": " + value + "\r\n" for key, value in fields.items()) +
               "\r\n").encode("ascii")
    started = now()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
    chunks, size = [], 0
    with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=2) as client:
        local, peer = list(client.getsockname()), list(client.getpeername())
        client.sendall(request)
        while True:
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                raise TimeoutError("HTTP response exceeded its overall deadline")
            client.settimeout(min(2, remaining))
            chunk = client.recv(4096)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
            if size > 65536:
                raise ValueError("HTTP response exceeded its size boundary")

Network Systems, Unit 11: Common Application Protocols.

A protocol specifies how peers interpret messages. A port identifies one part
of a transport endpoint; its number alone does not prove which application
answered. An observed TCP connection, HTTP response, trusted TLS identity and
successful application operation answer different questions. This lab supplies
one real HTTP service to make those distinctions inspectable.

Use Python 3.10 or newer, curl and ss in an external Linux terminal under an
ordinary account. No root account is needed. The program binds only 127.0.0.1
on a newly allocated port. It does not query a public host or change interfaces,
routes, firewall rules, resolver files, credentials or existing services. Keep
main.py, application_lab.py, network-notes.md and application-cases.md together.
The root README.md is this complete guide; the role README.md identifies the
selected role. Run from starter/ for an attempt or solution/ for a separate
reference. Both roles collect the same real observations. Python programming is
optional; only analyze(evidence) is incomplete in the starter.

An HTTP request combines a method, target, version and fields. The service replies
with a status, fields and, when appropriate, content. Read actual bytes before
interpreting them. Content-Type describes the representation; Content-Length
counts octets. A HEAD reply has metadata without transferred representation
content. The record includes base64 for exact binary bytes, because decoding
arbitrary content as text can destroy evidence. The laboratory deliberately
closes each connection, allowing its raw client to retain bytes through EOF.
It is a small HTTP/1.1 experiment, not a general HTTP parser or production server.

The report keeps the issuing namespace, ordinary UID, owned child PID, loopback
address and allocated port. Match the ss listener row to that PID and compare
the unique response token with the worker's request log. Client local/peer
addresses and server local/peer addresses should agree in opposite directions.

attempts a connection. Its refusal supplies a controlled comparison without a
successful HTTP response. A general timeout or refusal elsewhere would need
additional authorized evidence before assigning a cause.

application response. Run `python3 main.py` and predict five outcomes:
GET /unavailable, GET /missing, POST /state, GET /binary and GET /state with a
different Host field. Identify the request, peer and service owner before
classifying any failure or successful result.

classes and fields support different client decisions. They do not authorize
unlimited retries or imply that changing a route, port or firewall will fix

identity token. Compare the peer, port, PID and token with earlier exchanges.

"""Observe bounded HTTP exchanges with an owned ordinary-user loopback service."""
import base64
import contextlib
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import select
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from pathlib import Path


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def encoded(raw):
    return base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")


def command(argv, evidence):
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                             start_new_session=True)
    cleanup = "exited and reaped"
    try:
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=4)
    except BaseException:
        cleanup = "owned process group stopped and reaped"
        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.communicate(timeout=2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            child.communicate(timeout=2)
        raise
    finally:
        evidence["commands"].append({
            "parentTask": "application-protocol-observation", "parentPid": os.getpid(),
            "cwd": os.getcwd(), "command": argv, "pid": child.pid,
            "startTime": started, "endTime": now(), "exitCode": child.returncode,
            "timeoutSeconds": 4, "childProcessGroupCleanup": cleanup,
        })
    record = evidence["commands"][-1]
    record.update(stdout=out.decode("utf-8"), stderr=err.decode("utf-8"))
    return record


def serve(token, message, retry):
    requests = []

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        server_version = "OwnedApplicationLab/1"
        sys_version = ""

        def log_message(self, _format, *_args):
            pass

        def do_GET(self):
            self.respond()

        def do_HEAD(self):
            self.respond()

        def do_POST(self):
            self.respond()

        def respond(self):
            data = {"token": token, "message": message, "pid": os.getpid(),
                    "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
                    "port": self.server.server_port}
            representation = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True).encode() + b"\n"
            etag = '"' + hashlib.sha256(representation).hexdigest() + '"'
            status = 200
            fields = {"Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"}
            body = representation
            if self.command == "POST":
                status, fields["Allow"] = 405, "GET, HEAD"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "method not allowed"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/state":
                fields["ETag"] = etag
                fields["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
                if self.headers.get("If-None-Match") == etag:
                    status, body = 304, b""
            elif self.path == "/redirect":
                status, fields["Location"] = 307, "/state"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "next": "/state"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/unavailable":
                status, fields["Retry-After"] = 503, str(retry)
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "planned local unavailability"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/binary":
                fields["Content-Type"], body = "application/octet-stream", b"\x00\x01\xff\xfe"
            else:
                status = 404
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "resource not found"}).encode() + b"\n"
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Connection", "close")
            self.send_header("X-Lab-Token", token)
            for key, value in fields.items():
                self.send_header(key, value)
            # A 304 has no content. Omit Content-Length rather than advertising
            # a length that differs from the selected 200 representation.
            if status != 304:
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            actual_body = b"" if self.command == "HEAD" else body
            self.wfile.write(actual_body)
            self.wfile.flush()
            requests.append({
                "at": now(), "method": self.command, "path": self.path,
                "requestLine": self.raw_requestline.decode("ascii"),
                "requestHeaders": dict(self.headers), "status": status,
                "bodyBase64": encoded(actual_body), "etag": fields.get("ETag"),
                "local": list(self.connection.getsockname()),
                "peer": list(self.connection.getpeername()),
            })

    def stop(_signum, _frame):
        raise KeyboardInterrupt

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, stop)
    signal.alarm(45)
    server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
    server.timeout = 2
    ready = {"pid": os.getpid(), "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
             "port": server.server_port, "token": token}
    print(json.dumps({"ready": ready}), flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.05)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        print(json.dumps({"worker": ready, "requests": requests}), flush=True)
    return 0


def read_ready(child):
    readable, _, _ = select.select([child.stdout], [], [], 3)
    if not readable:
        raise TimeoutError("owned HTTP service did not announce readiness")
    raw = child.stdout.readline()
    if not raw or len(raw) > 2048:
        raise ValueError("invalid HTTP service readiness")
    return raw.decode("ascii"), json.loads(raw)["ready"]


def exchange(port, method, path, extra=None, host=None):
    host = host or "127.0.0.1:" + str(port)
    fields = {"Host": host, "Connection": "close", **(extra or {})}
    if method == "POST":
        fields["Content-Length"] = "0"
    request = (method + " " + path + " HTTP/1.1\r\n" +
               "".join(key + ": " + value + "\r\n" for key, value in fields.items()) +
               "\r\n").encode("ascii")
    started = now()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
    chunks, size = [], 0
    with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=2) as client:
        local, peer = list(client.getsockname()), list(client.getpeername())
        client.sendall(request)
        while True:
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                raise TimeoutError("HTTP response exceeded its overall deadline")
            client.settimeout(min(2, remaining))
            chunk = client.recv(4096)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
            if size > 65536:
                raise ValueError("HTTP response exceeded its size boundary")
    raw = b"".join(chunks)
    header, body = raw.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)
    lines = header.decode("ascii").split("\r\n")
    version, status, reason = lines[0].split(" ", 2)
    headers = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        key, value = line.split(":", 1)
        key = key.lower()
        if key in headers:
            raise ValueError("unexpected repeated response header")
        headers[key] = value.strip()
    return {"method": method, "path": path, "requestHeaders": fields,
            "requestBase64": encoded(request), "responseBase64": encoded(raw),
            "version": version, "status": int(status), "reason": reason,
            "headers": headers, "bodyBase64": encoded(body),
            "local": local, "peer": peer, "startTime": started, "endTime": now(),
            "readToEOF": True, "deadlineSeconds": 3, "responseLimitBytes": 65536}


def observe(kind, message, changed, hold_ms, evidence):
    if sys.platform != "linux" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise ValueError("use an ordinary account in an external Linux terminal")
    if kind not in ("core", "transfer", "extension"):
        raise ValueError("unknown application-protocol task")
    if not message or len(message.encode()) > 160 or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in message):
        raise ValueError("message must contain 1 to 160 printable UTF-8 bytes")
    if not 0 <= hold_ms <= 2000:
        raise ValueError("hold milliseconds must be between 0 and 2000")
    curl, ss = shutil.which("curl"), shutil.which("ss")
    if not curl or not ss:
        raise ValueError("curl and ss are required")
    retry = 2 if changed else 1
    evidence.update(kind=kind, environment={"platform": sys.platform, "uid": os.geteuid(),
                    "parentPid": os.getpid(), "networkNamespace": os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")},
                    message=message, changed=changed, retrySeconds=retry,
                    commands=[], exchanges=[], configuredSystemState=False,
                    dnsMeasured=False, tlsMeasured=False, sshMeasured=False,
                    suppliedCasesAreConstructed=True, learnerWorksheetCompletionInferred=False)
    token = uuid.uuid4().hex
    argv = [sys.executable, "-u", str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--serve", token, message, str(retry)]
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    proc = {"parentTask": "application-protocol-observation", "parentPid": os.getpid(),
            "cwd": os.getcwd(), "command": argv, "pid": child.pid, "startTime": started,
            "timeoutSeconds": 45, "readinessDeadlineSeconds": 3,
            "stopDeadlineSeconds": 3, "childProcessGroupCleanup": "pending"}
    evidence["serverProcess"] = proc
    control = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    port = None
    try:
        control.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        evidence["refusalControl"] = {"address": "127.0.0.1", "port": control.getsockname()[1],
                                      "heldWithoutListen": True}
        raw, ready = read_ready(child)
        evidence.update(readyLine=raw, ready=ready)
        if ready["pid"] != child.pid or ready["uid"] != os.geteuid() or ready["token"] != token:
            raise ValueError("service identity mismatch")
        port = ready["port"]
        evidence["workerProcUidFields"] = next(line.split()[1:] for line in
            Path("/proc/" + str(child.pid) + "/status").read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("Uid:"))
        evidence["listenersDuring"] = command([ss, "-H", "-ltnp", "sport = :" + str(port)], evidence)["stdout"]
        time.sleep(hold_ms / 1000)
        plans = {
            "core": [("GET", "/state"), ("HEAD", "/state"), ("GET", "/missing"),
                     ("POST", "/state"), ("GET", "/unavailable")],
            "transfer": [("GET", "/state"), ("GET", "/state"), ("GET", "/state"),
                         ("HEAD", "/state"), ("GET", "/redirect"), ("GET", "/state")],
            "extension": [("GET", "/unavailable"), ("GET", "/missing"),
                          ("POST", "/state"), ("GET", "/binary"), ("GET", "/state")],
        }
        for i, (method, path) in enumerate(plans[kind]):
            extra = None
            if kind == "transfer" and i in (1, 2):
                extra = {"If-None-Match": evidence["exchanges"][0]["headers"]["etag"] if i == 1 else '"stale-version"'}
            host = "representation.invalid" if kind == "extension" and i == 4 else None
            evidence["exchanges"].append(exchange(port, method, path, extra, host))
        common = [curl, "--noproxy", "*", "--http1.1", "--silent", "--show-error",
                  "--include", "--connect-timeout", "1", "--max-time", "2"]
        evidence["curlGet"] = command([*common, "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["curlHead"] = command([*common, "--head", "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["curlRefusal"] = command([*common, "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(control.getsockname()[1]) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["refusalControl"]["heldDuringProbe"] = True
    finally:
        control.close()
        if child.poll() is None:
            with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        cleanup = "owned service stopped and reaped"
        try:
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=2)
            cleanup = "owned service killed after deadline and reaped"
        proc.update(endTime=now(), exitCode=child.returncode, childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup,
                    stdout=out.decode("ascii"), stderr=err.decode("utf-8"))
        evidence["serverReaped"] = child.poll() is not None
        for line in out.splitlines():
            message_record = json.loads(line)
            if "ready" in message_record and "ready" not in evidence:
                evidence.update(readyLine=line.decode("ascii") + "\n", ready=message_record["ready"])
                port = evidence["ready"]["port"]
            if "worker" in message_record:
                evidence["workerResult"] = message_record
        if port is not None:
            evidence["listenersAfter"] = command([ss, "-H", "-ltnp", "sport = :" + str(port)], evidence)["stdout"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 5 or sys.argv[1] != "--serve" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise SystemExit(2)
    raise SystemExit(serve(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4])))

def serve(token, message, retry):
    requests = []

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        server_version = "OwnedApplicationLab/1"
        sys_version = ""

        def log_message(self, _format, *_args):
            pass

        def do_GET(self):
            self.respond()

        def do_HEAD(self):
            self.respond()

        def do_POST(self):
            self.respond()

        def respond(self):
            data = {"token": token, "message": message, "pid": os.getpid(),
                    "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
                    "port": self.server.server_port}
            representation = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True).encode() + b"\n"
            etag = '"' + hashlib.sha256(representation).hexdigest() + '"'
            status = 200
            fields = {"Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"}
            body = representation
            if self.command == "POST":
                status, fields["Allow"] = 405, "GET, HEAD"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "method not allowed"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/state":
                fields["ETag"] = etag
                fields["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache"
                if self.headers.get("If-None-Match") == etag:
                    status, body = 304, b""
            elif self.path == "/redirect":
                status, fields["Location"] = 307, "/state"
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "next": "/state"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/unavailable":
                status, fields["Retry-After"] = 503, str(retry)
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "planned local unavailability"}).encode() + b"\n"
            elif self.path == "/binary":
                fields["Content-Type"], body = "application/octet-stream", b"\x00\x01\xff\xfe"
            else:
                status = 404
                body = json.dumps({"token": token, "error": "resource not found"}).encode() + b"\n"
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Connection", "close")
            self.send_header("X-Lab-Token", token)
            for key, value in fields.items():
                self.send_header(key, value)
            # A 304 has no content. Omit Content-Length rather than advertising
            # a length that differs from the selected 200 representation.
            if status != 304:
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            actual_body = b"" if self.command == "HEAD" else body
            self.wfile.write(actual_body)
            self.wfile.flush()
            requests.append({
                "at": now(), "method": self.command, "path": self.path,
                "requestLine": self.raw_requestline.decode("ascii"),
                "requestHeaders": dict(self.headers), "status": status,
                "bodyBase64": encoded(actual_body), "etag": fields.get("ETag"),
                "local": list(self.connection.getsockname()),
                "peer": list(self.connection.getpeername()),
            })

    def stop(_signum, _frame):
        raise KeyboardInterrupt

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, stop)
    signal.alarm(45)
    server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
    server.timeout = 2
    ready = {"pid": os.getpid(), "uid": os.geteuid(), "address": "127.0.0.1",
             "port": server.server_port, "token": token}
    print(json.dumps({"ready": ready}), flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.05)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        print(json.dumps({"worker": ready, "requests": requests}), flush=True)
    return 0


def read_ready(child):
    readable, _, _ = select.select([child.stdout], [], [], 3)
    if not readable:
        raise TimeoutError("owned HTTP service did not announce readiness")
    raw = child.stdout.readline()
    if not raw or len(raw) > 2048:
        raise ValueError("invalid HTTP service readiness")
    return raw.decode("ascii"), json.loads(raw)["ready"]


def exchange(port, method, path, extra=None, host=None):
    host = host or "127.0.0.1:" + str(port)
    fields = {"Host": host, "Connection": "close", **(extra or {})}
    if method == "POST":
        fields["Content-Length"] = "0"
    request = (method + " " + path + " HTTP/1.1\r\n" +
               "".join(key + ": " + value + "\r\n" for key, value in fields.items()) +
               "\r\n").encode("ascii")
    started = now()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
    chunks, size = [], 0
    with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=2) as client:
        local, peer = list(client.getsockname()), list(client.getpeername())
        client.sendall(request)
        while True:
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                raise TimeoutError("HTTP response exceeded its overall deadline")
            client.settimeout(min(2, remaining))
            chunk = client.recv(4096)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
            if size > 65536:
                raise ValueError("HTTP response exceeded its size boundary")
    raw = b"".join(chunks)
    header, body = raw.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)
    lines = header.decode("ascii").split("\r\n")
    version, status, reason = lines[0].split(" ", 2)
    headers = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        key, value = line.split(":", 1)
        key = key.lower()
        if key in headers:
            raise ValueError("unexpected repeated response header")
        headers[key] = value.strip()
    return {"method": method, "path": path, "requestHeaders": fields,
            "requestBase64": encoded(request), "responseBase64": encoded(raw),
            "version": version, "status": int(status), "reason": reason,
            "headers": headers, "bodyBase64": encoded(body),
            "local": local, "peer": peer, "startTime": started, "endTime": now(),
            "readToEOF": True, "deadlineSeconds": 3, "responseLimitBytes": 65536}


def observe(kind, message, changed, hold_ms, evidence):
    if sys.platform != "linux" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise ValueError("use an ordinary account in an external Linux terminal")
    if kind not in ("core", "transfer", "extension"):
        raise ValueError("unknown application-protocol task")
    if not message or len(message.encode()) > 160 or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in message):
        raise ValueError("message must contain 1 to 160 printable UTF-8 bytes")
    if not 0 <= hold_ms <= 2000:
        raise ValueError("hold milliseconds must be between 0 and 2000")
    curl, ss = shutil.which("curl"), shutil.which("ss")
    if not curl or not ss:
        raise ValueError("curl and ss are required")
    retry = 2 if changed else 1
    evidence.update(kind=kind, environment={"platform": sys.platform, "uid": os.geteuid(),
                    "parentPid": os.getpid(), "networkNamespace": os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")},
                    message=message, changed=changed, retrySeconds=retry,
                    commands=[], exchanges=[], configuredSystemState=False,
                    dnsMeasured=False, tlsMeasured=False, sshMeasured=False,
                    suppliedCasesAreConstructed=True, learnerWorksheetCompletionInferred=False)
    token = uuid.uuid4().hex
    argv = [sys.executable, "-u", str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--serve", token, message, str(retry)]
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    proc = {"parentTask": "application-protocol-observation", "parentPid": os.getpid(),
            "cwd": os.getcwd(), "command": argv, "pid": child.pid, "startTime": started,
            "timeoutSeconds": 45, "readinessDeadlineSeconds": 3,
            "stopDeadlineSeconds": 3, "childProcessGroupCleanup": "pending"}
    evidence["serverProcess"] = proc
    control = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    port = None
    try:
        control.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        evidence["refusalControl"] = {"address": "127.0.0.1", "port": control.getsockname()[1],
                                      "heldWithoutListen": True}
        raw, ready = read_ready(child)
        evidence.update(readyLine=raw, ready=ready)
        if ready["pid"] != child.pid or ready["uid"] != os.geteuid() or ready["token"] != token:
            raise ValueError("service identity mismatch")
        port = ready["port"]
        evidence["workerProcUidFields"] = next(line.split()[1:] for line in
            Path("/proc/" + str(child.pid) + "/status").read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("Uid:"))
        evidence["listenersDuring"] = command([ss, "-H", "-ltnp", "sport = :" + str(port)], evidence)["stdout"]
        time.sleep(hold_ms / 1000)
        plans = {
            "core": [("GET", "/state"), ("HEAD", "/state"), ("GET", "/missing"),
                     ("POST", "/state"), ("GET", "/unavailable")],
            "transfer": [("GET", "/state"), ("GET", "/state"), ("GET", "/state"),
                         ("HEAD", "/state"), ("GET", "/redirect"), ("GET", "/state")],
            "extension": [("GET", "/unavailable"), ("GET", "/missing"),
                          ("POST", "/state"), ("GET", "/binary"), ("GET", "/state")],
        }
        for i, (method, path) in enumerate(plans[kind]):
            extra = None
            if kind == "transfer" and i in (1, 2):
                extra = {"If-None-Match": evidence["exchanges"][0]["headers"]["etag"] if i == 1 else '"stale-version"'}
            host = "representation.invalid" if kind == "extension" and i == 4 else None
            evidence["exchanges"].append(exchange(port, method, path, extra, host))
        common = [curl, "--noproxy", "*", "--http1.1", "--silent", "--show-error",
                  "--include", "--connect-timeout", "1", "--max-time", "2"]
        evidence["curlGet"] = command([*common, "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["curlHead"] = command([*common, "--head", "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["curlRefusal"] = command([*common, "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(control.getsockname()[1]) + "/state"], evidence)
        evidence["refusalControl"]["heldDuringProbe"] = True
    finally:
        control.close()
        if child.poll() is None:
            with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        cleanup = "owned service stopped and reaped"
        try:
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            out, err = child.communicate(timeout=2)
            cleanup = "owned service killed after deadline and reaped"
        proc.update(endTime=now(), exitCode=child.returncode, childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup,
                    stdout=out.decode("ascii"), stderr=err.decode("utf-8"))
        evidence["serverReaped"] = child.poll() is not None
        for line in out.splitlines():
            message_record = json.loads(line)
            if "ready" in message_record and "ready" not in evidence:
                evidence.update(readyLine=line.decode("ascii") + "\n", ready=message_record["ready"])
                port = evidence["ready"]["port"]
            if "worker" in message_record:
                evidence["workerResult"] = message_record
        if port is not None:
            evidence["listenersAfter"] = command([ss, "-H", "-ltnp", "sport = :" + str(port)], evidence)["stdout"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 5 or sys.argv[1] != "--serve" or os.geteuid() == 0:
        raise SystemExit(2)
    raise SystemExit(serve(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4])))

These fictional records are supplied for reasoning. They were not generated by
the loopback program and do not describe an external site.

## A: a negative DNS answer and a transport failure

An explicit DNS query to an authorized local resolver for missing.example.invalid
returns NXDOMAIN. Another query to a different selected resolver receives no
reply before its deadline. Neither record includes an application connection.
Identify which result is a DNS message and which has no received DNS response.
State what additional authorized observation is needed before blaming an HTTP
listener. Reuse the earlier DNS/NSS lab's distinction between explicit DNS and
system name-service lookup; do not treat this fictional table as a new lookup.

## B: TLS identity and an HTTP decision

One HTTPS client reports an untrusted certificate issuer before receiving any
HTTP status. A second, separately scoped test establishes a trusted TLS identity
for its intended host and receives HTTP 401. Explain why the two records do not
locate the same boundary. A 401 alone does not prove application account access.
Do not disable certificate checks as a substitute for identifying the intended
peer, applicable trust configuration and authorized authentication method.

## C: SSH server identity and account authentication

A client connects but reports a changed server host key. A separate connection
whose expected host key is independently verified reaches an account prompt and
ends with public-key authentication denied. Separate transport, host identity
and account authorization. Identify the trusted evidence needed before changing
a remembered host key. Neither record establishes a successful remote command.

For each case, preserve the stated issuing context, earliest unsupported
boundary, two possible explanations when appropriate, next authorized check and
what that check would fail to prove. No remediation is performed by this file.
